title: Respiration
description: With air, a cell burns sugar all the way to carbon dioxide and gets fifteen times as much from it, pumping protons across a membrane to drive its turbine. Unlocks the Living Cell.

puzzle.goal: A proton gradient of p pH units and a voltage V (mV) drive the turbine together. Write the total push F, in mV, 59 mV for each pH unit.
puzzle.name: Proton-motive force
puzzle.ask: Find F for V = @{V} and p = @{p}.
puzzle.method: Each pH unit is a tenfold concentration difference, worth RT ln 10 / F = 59 mV at body heat.
